title: Remote patient-monitoring platform
summary: A web platform that pulls readings from multiple health devices into one dashboard for clinicians, with a HIPAA-conscious architecture.
problem: Clinical teams need vitals from many different consumer and medical devices in one place, reliably and securely, without manual data entry.
approach: Integrate multiple device and health-data APIs behind a single, consistent internal model
Stream updates to the dashboard in near real time
Design access controls and audit logging appropriate for health data
Build for predictable performance as usage grows

title: Multi-vendor e-commerce platform
summary: A marketplace connecting many sellers and buyers, with catalog search, inventory, and reliable checkout across payment providers.
problem: Growing marketplaces struggle with search performance, slow checkout, and the operational load of onboarding new vendors.
approach: Fast, SEO-friendly storefront with server-rendered pages
Search powered by a dedicated search engine for speed at scale
Caching to keep response times low under load
Resilient payment integration with sensible fraud handling

title: Legacy insurance platform modernization
summary: Incrementally replacing an ageing insurance application with modern services — without a risky big-bang rewrite.
problem: A long-lived platform on dated technology becomes slow, risky to change, and hard to hire for — but can't go offline.
approach: Use the Strangler Fig pattern to replace functionality piece by piece
Run new and old systems in parallel while traffic shifts gradually
Containerized, cloud-hosted services for easier deployment
Asynchronous processing for long-running tasks like claims

title: AI-assisted document processing
summary: A pipeline that reads documents like invoices and forms, extracts structured data, and routes edge cases to a human for review.
problem: Teams spend hours manually reading and re-keying documents, which is slow and error-prone.
approach: Use language and vision models to extract and structure document data
Route low-confidence results to a human-review step rather than trusting them blindly
Feed corrections back to improve accuracy over time
Expose a simple interface for reviewers

title: Business analytics dashboard
summary: A reporting platform that pulls data from several sources into interactive dashboards and custom reports.
problem: Decision-makers need trustworthy, up-to-date views across data that lives in many separate systems.
approach: Consolidate sources into a warehouse with clear data pipelines
Interactive, performant visualizations
A flexible report builder for non-technical users
Scheduled refreshes and alerting
